description: This file contains Spring Security configuration for a Java web application. It defines security settings including permitted endpoints, disabling CSRF and frame options for H2 console, and enforcing HTTP Basic authentication for other endpoints. The configuration ensures specific public endpoints like API documentation, health checks, and H2 console are accessible without authentication, while securing other requests.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Spring Security configuration class that defines security filter chains and security settings for the web application.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain with settings for CSRF, frame options, authorized endpoints, and HTTP Basic authentication.
